claims: April Fools' Day is celebrated annually on April 1.
April Fools' Day in 2026 falls on a Wednesday.
April Fools' Day in 2027 will be on a Thursday.
April Fools' Day is recognized for playing practical jokes, hoaxes, and pranks.
In some traditions, such as in the UK and Ireland, it is customary to end the pranks at noon.
